socket: HTTP127.0.0.1:8796 (container8796); Docker Desktop named pipe previously diagnosed separately
cause: Public image lacked SOURCE_STORAGE_PATH; default /app/work is intentionally not writable by the runtime
fix: Set SOURCE_STORAGE_PATH=/var/data/sources in image; existing writable data volume owns only this runtime data. No chmod/ACL reset. Extend restart regression to fetch/hash every original source and deny other owner.
